title: Design system, app shell, and i18n-ready copy catalog
description: Introduce Tailwind and shadcn/ui primitives, build the persistent app shell (header, lock action, user menu, theme toggle), and centralize all user-facing strings in an English catalog so a second locale can be added later. Requirement ID: TASK-5.
acceptanceCriteria: Tailwind CSS and the selected shadcn/ui primitives are installed and themed with CSS variables
App shell renders on every route with header, user menu placeholder, manual lock button, and theme toggle
Light, dark, and system themes work and persist across reloads
Every visible string is referenced from a single message catalog (`app/lib/i18n/en.ts`)
No third-party scripts, remote fonts, or analytics are loaded
No inline `<style>` or `<script>` is emitted by components

steps.details: Add Tailwind with the Vite plugin. Create `app/app.css` with theme tokens (background, foreground, muted, primary, destructive, border, ring) for light and dark. Set `font-family` to a system font stack; do not load remote fonts.

Initialize shadcn/ui (new-york style, CSS variables). Add only the primitives needed by the MVP: button, input, label, textarea, select, checkbox, dialog, alert-dialog, dropdown-menu, toast/sonner, tooltip, sheet, skeleton, badge, switch, tabs.

Create `app/lib/i18n/types.ts` (flat key union) and `app/lib/i18n/en.ts` with namespaced keys such as `auth.login.title`, `vault.list.empty`, `common.save`. Add a `t(key, params?)` helper that throws in development on a missing key and falls back to the key in production.

Create `app/components/app-shell.tsx` exporting `AppShell` with a sticky header (product mark, lock button slot, user menu slot, theme toggle), a main content area with max-width container, and a footer-free layout. Make the header responsive down to 360px.

Add a theme provider that writes `class="dark"` on `<html>` and stores the preference in localStorage under a non-sensitive key. Default to system. Apply the theme class in `root.tsx` before hydration to avoid flash.

Create minimal route modules in `app/routes/` for `/login`, `/setup`, `/app`, and `/app/trash`, each rendering a page entry `app/features/<feature>/<feature>.tsx` with `index.ts` (features: `login`, `setup`, `vault-list`, `vault-trash`). Headings come from the catalog. Nothing functional yet.
Run the app at 360px, 768px, and 1280px. Confirm no remote requests in the network panel, no inline style/script violations, every string resolves through the catalog, and the theme survives reload.

technicalNotes: English only in MVP; the catalog structure is the i18n readiness requirement, not translated strings.
Do not add any analytics or error-reporting script; observability is server-side only.
Keep the shell free of vault-specific logic so it can render before unlock.

pullRequest.title: feat(ui): design system, app shell, and copy catalog
pullRequest.scope: Tailwind theme, shadcn primitives, shell, theme provider, message catalog, placeholder routes.
pullRequest.outOfScope: Auth logic, vault UI, accessibility pass, responsive polish beyond the shell.
